description: Owns the task-specific network requirement profile, input gaps, readiness checklist and smallest deterministic analysis.
responsibilities: Translate the user's planning goal into a versioned data_requirement_profile.v1 and require whole-profile confirmation.
Inspect source_profile.v1 and mapping_proposal.v1 evidence without reading raw files; publish typed input_gap.v1 and analysis_readiness_review.v1.
Consume planning-dataset.v2 only after mapping, units, relationships and business parameters are confirmed.
Evaluate current coverage and cost, then solve the finite candidate warehouse set only when the confirmed Profile requests optimization.
Publish generic network snapshot, coverage, facility-location solution, scenario comparison, bounded map and report Resources with explicit assumptions.
Publish the complete business report as one cross-checked Resource and one typed report.v1 delivery reference, leaving browser map Artifact delivery to the Visualization Agent.
risks: Results are exact only for the reviewed finite candidates, declared assignments, capacities, rates and route facts.
Haversine distance multiplied by the declared road factor is a planning approximation, not a navigation promise.
